deadline.value: International applicants should apply by February 1, 2027 for priority review; the standard deadline is June 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Fall - Priority U.S. CITIZEN February 1 INTERNATIONAL February 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE is required, so there is no subject test.

gre_general.value: No GRE General score is required.

supervisor.value: You must find a faculty mentor who agrees to supervise you, and their intent-to-mentor letter is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: requires an intent to mentor letter (an agreement from one of our faculty members to supervise your research project) as part of the application process

also.quote: Prospective students must contact doctoral faculty members to identify an individual willing to serve as their major advisor prior to submitting their application to the graduate program

funding.value: Doctoral instructional and teaching assistantships are awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: offers doctoral instructional assistantships and teaching assistantships on a competitive basis

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with a bachelor's degree in a natural science field (3.5 GPA) or with a master's in one.
entry_route.quote: Baccalaureate degree in biology, chemistry, engineering, geology, or a related natural science field from a regionally accredited university | Master's degree in biology, chemistry, engineering, geology, or a related natural science field from a regionally accredited university

notes: The Graduate College page also calls this program Aquatic Resources and Integrative Biology.
